correctness.rationale: The pair parameterization has generic degree two and Chow pullback h1+h2, giving a binomial times squared Grassmannian degree. The quadric parameterization is generically birational from P(Sym^2 S^vee), whose Chow line bundle has first Chern class xi+2h; pushing powers of xi gives Segre classes, and equivariant localization yields the finite sum for all n,p. Dimensions and dominance follow by algebra. Standalone exact verifier checked six pairs against two weight assignments and five against a separate Vandermonde/Grassmann coefficient computation; the universal theorem is a proof, not an extrapolation.

originality.rationale: New claimed content is an all-(p,n) formula for both Chow-projective degrees and exact top-dimensional component-crossing rule. The known (p,n)=(1,3) degrees 92,140 in arXiv:1508.07219 are explicitly credited. The recent arXiv:2610.39498v1 studies topology, rather than the same all-parameter degrees in inspected sections. Actual published-finding corpus searches and own-ledger claims revealed no implication covering the formulas. Earlier general projective-bundle work might implicitly contain similar specializations; priority is qualified.

value.rationale: Both component degrees in the canonical Chow-form embedding are natural enumerative invariants, refining the topological component description and extending the known isolated 2015 conic computation. The all-parameter crossover precisely tells which components contribute to the reduced non-equidimensional Chow variety degree; examples range from 2865 for surface cycles in P4 to a first higher tie 295115130128. This is an intrinsically motivated two-parameter family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
